## Safety checklist

- [ ] No credentials, private source or local paths in code, tests, fixtures or logs
- [ ] Does not widen what leaves the machine, what sessions can reach, or what is written to GitHub — or the PR explains why
- [ ] README / site docs / CHANGELOG updated if user-visible behavior changed
